title: The anchor you leave behind
header_line: My analysis of one book on authority and personal brand. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What does someone feel when you walk out of the room?
A student said: pre-engagement is what your audience sees before they interact with you: blog posts, social media, website, bio, everything that gives you credibility.
Another said that post-engagement is delivering on the promise they learned in pre-engagement.
I said that pre-engagement is the promise of who you are as a personal brand, and that post-engagement is your performance backing it up. I said I research a person for a month before a meeting.
I asked what thought, emotion or image you leave people with, and said you control it, but you have to anchor it on purpose. I said to keep it simple, relevant and repeatable.
I said: when I think of you I think of transforming creativity into profitability. You have to pick what you are comfortable saying, your tagline.
A student said that after a success you can say: it went wonderfully because you believed in me; thanks to you we did it. People appreciate that and it sets up a long-term relationship.
I said that is brilliant: giving praise to somebody else and saying we could not have done it without you is a beautiful anchor.
I said that every month you can put two or three more links out with articles you write, until you have two hundred, driving your message.
I said that in a meeting you share the responsibility by asking questions, not shoving your knowledge down someone's throat.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write what you want people to feel when you leave.
Write the thank-you you will say after your next success.
Write what you will publish this month.
Write three questions that share the responsibility.

check.q: What did a student say pre-engagement is?
choices: What the audience sees before they interact with you

check.q: What did I say you do with the anchor?
What did a student say after a success?
choices: Thank the client for the belief

recap: Leave a chosen anchor. Share the credit. Publish every month.
